title: Nehru Place Market Delhi - IT Hub, Shopping, Timings & Travel Guide, Nehru Place IT hub,
content:
Nehru Place - Delhi,

Nehru Place Market in Delhi is famously known as India’s largest IT hub. If you’re looking for laptops, computers, software, or mobile accessories, this market is the place to be. From big brand showrooms to small vendors selling affordable gadgets, Nehru Place is a paradise for tech lovers. Apart from electronics, it also offers clothing, fabrics, and street food, making it a buzzing commercial hub.

History & Overview:

Developed in the late 1980s as a commercial district, Nehru Place soon became the IT capital of India. Today, it is not just a market but a business hub with offices, computer shops, and service centers. The market is always alive with energy, with people flocking in for gadget repairs, wholesale deals, and affordable accessories.

What Makes It Special

The market is popular for budget-friendly gadgets and accessories. You can find everything from the latest laptops, printers, and software to second-hand spare parts. The area is also home to Eros Corporate Tower and several eateries, making it a mix of business and leisure.

Things to Shop For:

  • Laptops, desktops, and tablets,
  • Computer hardware and spare parts,
  • Mobile phones and accessories,
  • Printers, scanners, and cables,
  • Software (licensed and budget-friendly versions),
  • Fabrics and textiles (nearby stalls),

Food & Eateries:

Besides tech shopping, Nehru Place has a vibrant street food culture. You’ll find momo stalls, chole bhature vendors, and South Indian eateries. Popular food spots include Sona Sweets, Calcutta, and Epicuria Food Mall (adjacent to the metro station).

Entry Fee & Timings:

  • Entry Fee: Free
  • Timings: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM (Closed on Sundays)

How to Reach:

  • Nearest Metro Station: Nehru Place Metro Station (Violet Line).
  • By Road: Well-connected by buses, taxis, and autos.
  • Parking: Paid parking available near the market, but finding a spot can be difficult during peak hours.

Places to Visit Nearby:

  • Lotus Temple.
  • Kalkaji Mandir.
  • ISKCON Temple (East of Kailash).
  • Epicuria Food Mall.

Travel Tips:

  • Bargain before finalizing a deal, especially for accessories and hardware.
  • Double-check product authenticity before buying.
  • Carry cash, as some small vendors may not accept cards/UPI.
  • Weekdays are better to avoid crowds and parking issues.
excerpt: Nehru Place Market is a bustling IT and commercial hub of Delhi, perfect for those looking for laptops, mobiles, accessories, and gadgets at competitive rates. Along with its vibrant street food culture and nearby attractions like the Lotus Temple and ISKCON Temple, it makes for a complete shopping and cultural experience.
